description: This Java class implements the AccountAssociationsReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve and check account association data, particularly linked accounts for loans and savings, using JDBC template queries.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service to read account associations, including linked accounts for loans and savings, and checking active associations.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to AccountAssociationsData objects.

methods.name: retriveLoanLinkedAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves linked account data for a given loan ID.

methods.name: retriveLoanAssociations
methods.description: Retrieves all account associations for a given loan ID and association type.

methods.name: retriveSavingsLinkedAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves linked account data for a given savings account ID.

methods.name: isLinkedWithAnyActiveAccount
methods.description: Checks if a savings account is linked with any active loan or savings account.

methods.name: retriveSavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves savings account data for a given savings account ID.
